command:
set -euo pipefail; T=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/go-domscale.XXXX); PORT=9237; /usr/bin/google-chrome --headless=new --no-sandbox --remote-allow-origins='*' --remote-debugging-port=$PORT --user-data-dir=$T/profile --window-size=958,523 http://127.0.0.1:8788/ >$T/chrome.out 2>$T/chrome.err & CP=$!; cleanup(){ kill $CP 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf $T; }; trap cleanup EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/json >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep .1; done; sleep 2; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,time,sys
try:
 import websocket
except Exception as e:
 print('WEBSOCKET_IMPORT_FAIL',repr(e)); raise SystemExit(77)
PORT=9237
pages=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/json'))
p=next(x for x in pages if x.get('type')=='page')
ws=websocket.create_connection(p['webSocketDebuggerUrl'],timeout=10)
expr=r'''JSON.stringify((()=>{const r=document.getElementById('gesicht-rahmen'),k=document.getElementById('kopf-canvas'),kd=document.getElementById('kopf-dreh'),b=document.getElementById('koerper-dreh');const R=x=>{const q=x.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:q.x,y:q.y,w:q.width,h:q.height}};return {inner:[innerWidth,innerHeight],dpr:devicePixelRatio,rahmen_offset:[r.offsetWidth,r.offsetHeight],rahmen_rect:R(r),kopf_canvas_rect:R(k),kopf_dreh_rect:R(kd),koerper_dreh_rect:R(b),scale:_kopfCanvasScale,head_source_shift_to_css:{a025:0.25*_kopfCanvasScale,a05:0.5*_kopfCanvasScale,a075:0.75*_kopfCanvasScale,a10:1.0*_kopfCanvasScale,a15:1.5*_kopfCanvasScale,a20:2.0*_kopfCanvasScale},fps:window.__buehneFps||null}})())'''
ws.send(json.dumps({'id':1,'method':'Runtime.evaluate','params':{'expression':expr,'returnByValue':True}}))
while True:
 m=json.loads(ws.recv())
 if m.get('id')==1:
  print('DOM_METRICS',m['result']['result'].get('value')); break
ws.close()
PY
echo LIVE_SUBJECT; sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service
